title: Reef expands in Cebu with first standalone footwear store at SM City Cebu

blocks.text: Reef has officially opened its first standalone footwear store in Cebu at SM City Cebu on October 3, 2026, bringing the globally recognized beach-inspired footwear brand closer to Cebuano consumers and the city’s active, outdoor-loving community. The grand opening celebrated Reef’s long-standing connection to beach and surf culture while introducing a dedicated retail space focused entirely on footwear. From beach days and island adventures to everyday city walks, the new store offers footwear designed around comfort, versatility, and an active lifestyle. “This is very special for us to officially bring Reef closer to the Cebuano community,” said Primer Group of Companies […]...
